# Generated by tools/codegen/gen_controller.py from controllers/esp32-t12-controller/controller.toml. Do not edit; change the description and regenerate.
# t12_host: the controller on a PC (Linux, WSL): the same control task, console and tables
# as the board, with the plant behind the HIL link (src/io_hil.c, libs/hil) instead of the on-chip
# simulation; and t12_scenarios, its closed-loop scenarios on the on-chip plant:
#   cmake -S host -B <build> && cmake --build <build>
#   <build>/t12_host --device /dev/pts/N [--lockstep | --hz 1000] [--log] [-c "sp ..."]
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(t12_host C)
include(../../../cmake/krumpir.cmake)

krumpir_add_libs()
krumpir_add_subdirectory_once(t12ctrl ../lib/t12ctrl t12ctrl)

set(srcs
  ../src/console.c
  ../src/control_task.c
  ../src/gen/ctrl_gen.c
  ../src/io_hil.c)
add_executable(t12_host ${srcs})
target_include_directories(t12_host PRIVATE ../src)
target_compile_definitions(t12_host PRIVATE KRUMPIR_IO_HIL)
# relaxed: the board's hook signatures keep parameters they do not use
target_link_libraries(t12_host PRIVATE t12ctrl rte hil_host krumpir::warnings_relaxed)

# The SIL side of tools/hil/compare.py
add_executable(t12_scenarios ../tools/scenarios.c)
target_link_libraries(t12_scenarios PRIVATE t12ctrl krumpir::warnings)

# XCP on UDP (XCPlite, Linux) for the TUI and xcpclient: -DKRUMPIR_XCP=ON, then run with
# --xcp <port> and make the A2L from this ELF (controllers/README.md, "XCP on the PC build").
# Every build has a new EPK.
option(KRUMPIR_XCP "XCP on UDP (XCPlite)" OFF)
if(KRUMPIR_XCP)
  set(XCPLITE_CFG_OVERRIDE ${KRUMPIR_LIBS_DIR}/osal_host/xcplib_host_cfg.h)
  add_subdirectory(${KRUMPIR_LIBS_DIR}/vendor/XCPlite xcplite EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  krumpir_vendor(xcplite)
  add_custom_target(t12_epk BYPRODUCTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/xcp_epk.h
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DOUT=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/xcp_epk.h
            -P ${KRUMPIR_LIBS_DIR}/osal_host/xcp_epk.cmake)
  add_dependencies(t12_host t12_epk)
  target_sources(t12_host PRIVATE ${KRUMPIR_LIBS_DIR}/osal_host/src/xcp_host.c)
  target_include_directories(t12_host PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
  target_compile_definitions(t12_host PRIVATE KRUMPIR_XCP CTRL_NAME="t12_host")
  target_compile_options(t12_host PRIVATE -g) # the A2L is read from the debug info
  target_link_libraries(t12_host PRIVATE xcplite)
endif()
